0 Big Time Soccer Soccer (or 'non-American football') is easily the most popular sport in the world, with an estimated fan base of 3.5 billion. 'Big Time Soccer' is a card-driven game based on the most comprehensive statistics available, and will delight players with an accurate number of shots at net, goals scored, etc., and features fast, streamlined play. All the elements of pro soccer are here, including corner kicks, fouls, free kicks, goal kicks, penalty kicks, dribbling, passing, tackles (with yellow and red cards) and intercepted passes. So put on your jersey and shin guards, and get ready for some soccer! Number of players: 2 Game duration: 52 mn Complexity: 2 / 5 Play Big Time Soccer and 1414 other games online. [Rating: 1/10] The worst game I've played on BGA. Unplayable, and even if it was fixed it wouldn't have mechanics in the design to make it worth playing for the amount of time it takes to play. Absolutely the worst.

[Rating: 1/10] Awful, awful mechanics. Played on BGA and just as other have said, it is absolutely unforgivable at times. More than half of the first period I was only able to watch my opponent pass the ball back and forth while he couldn't shoot. Penalties, clears, and shots on goal are extremely hard to have a success and honestly need to have some variability based upon where the ball is located, where it is heading, etc. No momentum builds or high successes that grant extra cards, like Ice Cold Ice Hockey. [Rating: 1/10] This is a fantastic gateway game for those transitioning from Candy Land to Chutes and Ladders, but is unsatisfied with the flashy, pretty, colorful design of those "games".

[Rating: 1/10] Awful game. Played on BGA. Twice. Spent almost all the game passing the ball around and not being able to shoot. Then having no defensive cards and no way to discard on defense to be able to do anything. Absolute waste of time.

[Rating: 1/10] A game by a designer who thought he was making a simple yet strategic war-like game. But due to inexperience or incompetence it just ends up being too long and almost completely random.

[Rating: 1/10] Comedically bad.  If someone were trying to come up with the worst game possible, they might come up with the rule "after shooting, roll a D20 and consult a chart to see what happens, where only a perfect 20 gets the actual result you were going for." Weirdly, this does simulate a real soccer match sort of well.  Edit: Lowering my rating from 2 to 1.  Having played the game 3 times, I can say now with absolute confidence this is the worst game I have ever played.

[Rating: 1/10] It’s the worst game I’ve come across in my quest to play all of the games on BGA.

[Rating: 2/10] Played it on BGA. I hate it for - The very slim chances of successful shots - The very slim chances of having the cards that you can actually use at the moment in your hand

[Rating: 2/10] Incredibly full of luck, especially coming from a designer that rags on other  designs for being too luck based. While the end result does emulate the pacing and back and forth of a soccer game, it isn't fun to play. Most of the time you have no meaningful decisions and just play the cards that make sense for you to play and hope you draw something to follow up that play. Iconography isn't great but is a step up from similar games from this designer.
